run.dirty.hidden-flags: · some files carry a flag that hides changes
run.unverified: Warning: some checks could not run because a tool is missing or gave no result: {checks}. They do not count as failed. The reason is kept in the evidence file
run.dirty-full.changes: Uncommitted changes are present, so the full profile ends as failed. This run cannot back a release. Commit, then run it again
run.dirty-full.hidden-flags: Some files carry the assume-unchanged or skip-worktree flag, so the full profile ends as failed. git does not report edits to those files, so the checked content may differ from the commit. Find them with `git ls-files -v`, clear the flags, then run it again
run.dirty-full.no-repo: This is not a git repository, so the full profile ends as failed. A release needs a commit to point at. Commit inside a git repository, then run it again
reason.baseline-unlogged: the baseline file holds an increase that the relock log does not. Restore the baseline file or lock it again with gate.mjs --relock
reason.log-without-values: the last relock log line has no per-file values, so the baseline cannot be compared. Lock it again with gate.mjs --relock <check> --reason "<why>" --allow-increase --decision <ID>
reason.current-missing: the check returned no values to compare with the baseline
reason.check-error: the check ended with an error
ratchet.new-rules: Rules missing from the baseline: {rules}. A relock will lock them too.
relock.written: Baselines and the relock log were written.
relock.nothing-written: A check was refused, so nothing was written.
relock.refused.increase-needs-decision: refused. Values went up. --allow-increase --decision <ID> is required
relock.refused.moves-overlap: Refused. The same file appears in two --moves entries (as from or to). Overlapping moves are ignored and files are compared one by one. To lock anyway, pass --allow-increase --decision <ID>
relock.refused.log-without-values: Refused. The last relock log line has no per-file values, so an increase cannot be ruled out. Lock it again with a decision ID: --allow-increase --decision <ID>
relock.refused.decision-not-found: refused. No decision file in docs/decisions/: {decision}
relock.refused.no-current: refused. The check returned no values to lock
relock.refused.check-skipped: refused. The check skipped itself, so there is nothing to lock: {note}
relock.skipped: skipped. The check did not run, so it was not locked: {note}
relock.nothing-to-lock: No check was locked. Nothing was written.
problem.config-not-found: lanekit.config.json was not found. It belongs in the repository root
problem.baseline-missing: {path}: mode is ratchet but there is no baseline. Lock one first: gate.mjs --relock {got} --reason "<why>"
problem.baseline-broken: {path}: the baseline file is malformed. Lock it again
problem.blocked-path: {path}: not written. It is a symbolic link, points outside the repository, or a file sits where a folder should be. Replace it with a real file or folder, then run again
problem.not-ratchetable: {path}: this check does not use a baseline. Use warn or fail
problem.check-contract: {path}: the check module does not follow the contract (meta.id · meta.profiles · run)
problem.denylist-missing: {path}: The repository is public but there is no denylist. Set LANEKIT_DENYLIST or put it at ~/.config/lanekit/denylist.txt
problem.denylist-invalid: {path}: Line {got} of the denylist is not a valid regular expression
problem.denylist-empty: {path}: The repository is public but the denylist has no rules
usage.bad-profile: Unknown profile: {detail}. Use light, changed or full
usage.unknown-check: Unknown check: {detail}. Run gate.mjs --list to see the list
usage.relock-target-missing: Put a check ID or all after --relock
usage.check-not-installed: Cannot relock, the check file is missing: {detail}
usage.not-ratchetable: This check does not use a baseline: {detail}
usage.bad-moves: Cannot read the --moves file: {detail}. Expected shape: [{ "from": "…", "to": ["…"] }]
